test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Describe how you will tell your friends that someone has picked Suman’s pocket in passive voice.

options.text: Someone has being picked Suman’s pocket.

solution:
The correct answer is Option (4) "**Suman's pocket has been picked." ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in **passive voice**, which means the subject of given sentence will not do any work itself.
 
• Instead, the focus is on the object **(Suman's pocket) **and the action that was done to it (picked).
 
• The verb** "picked" **is in the past participle form, which is used in passive voice constructions.
 
• It is formed by adding "-ed" to regular verbs or using the third form of irregular verbs.
 
• The auxiliary verb "has been" is used to form **the present perfect passive tense**. This indicates that the action happened at an unspecified time before now and has ongoing effects.
 
• In active voice, the sentence would be **"Someone has picked Suman's pocket." **The subject (someone) is doing the action (picking), and the object (Suman's pocket) is receiving the action.

Therefore,the correct answer is option no.**(4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1,** "Someone has being picked Suman's pocket,"** is incorrect because "being" is not needed in passive voice constructions. It also uses the wrong form of the verb "pick." -
 
• Option 2, **"Suman's pocket had picked," **is incorrect because it uses the wrong form of the verb "pick" and the wrong tense. "Had picked" is past perfect, which is used to indicate an action that was completed before another past action. -
 
• Option 3,** "Suman's pocket been picked,"** is incorrect because it is missing the auxiliary verb "has been" and the main verb "picked" is in the wrong form.
